$comment: Machine-readable Firestore data model for SmartJib. Kept in lockstep with src/lib/store.ts, src/lib/db.ts and firestore.rules by tests/blueprint.test.ts — run `npm run test` after changing any of them.
description: SmartJib stores private finance records under /users/{uid}, shared workspaces under /households/{householdId}, and verified-email invitations at /householdInvites/{inviteId}. Monthly and savings documents are revisioned and paired with immutable ledger entries. Darat circles live under /circles/{circleId} (shared, organizer-owned) with per-member subcollections and an invite pool at /daratInvites/{inviteId}. Each member keeps a lightweight pointer at /users/{uid}/circles/{circleId} so the dashboard can list the user's circles without scanning.

IncomeSource.title: IncomeSource
IncomeSource.description: A single income stream contributing to the month's total budget.

payDay.description: Day of the month (1-31) this salary/income is paid; used as the source's monthly start date

VariableExpense.title: VariableExpense
VariableExpense.description: A day-to-day expense logged against a category and a money place.

type.description: Category name, must exist in MonthBudget.activeCategories

place.description: Money source id (bank, home, wallet, or a user-defined location)

person.description: Household member the expense belongs to

FixedExpense.title: FixedExpense
FixedExpense.description: A recurring bill. `base` stores the planned amount so overspend can be measured.

type.description: Category name, must exist in MonthBudget.activeCategories

date.description: Due day such as "1st" or "15th", or a YYYY-MM-DD date

place.description: Money source id (bank, home, wallet, or a user-defined location)

person.description: Household member the bill belongs to

FixedCategoryItem.title: FixedCategoryItem
FixedCategoryItem.description: Custom fixed-bill category stored on the user profile.

SavingGoal.title: SavingGoal
SavingGoal.description: A global saving goal. Months move money into or out of it; it never resets at rollover.

source.description: Money source id (bank, home, wallet, or a user-defined location)

deposited.description: Money actually deposited into this goal (fund flow or checkbox transfer). Excludes bookkeeping "already saved" balances recorded without the transfer checkbox; the home-screen savings plan sums only this.

DebtItem.title: DebtItem
DebtItem.description: Money owed to someone ('debt') or owed to the user ('credit').

name.description: Person or entity on the other side

SavingsActivityEntry.title: SavingsActivityEntry
SavingsActivityEntry.description: One savings deposit or withdrawal logged on the month for Recent Activity.

actorMemberId.description: Household member who made the movement (shared goal contributions).

CustomRatios.title: CustomRatios
CustomRatios.description: User-defined allocation for the 'custom' strategy. Fractions of income that always sum to 1.

MoneyPlaceConfig.title: MoneyPlaceConfig
MoneyPlaceConfig.description: A tracked cash location the user can rename, add or remove from Profile.

SessionItem.title: SessionItem
SessionItem.description: Immutable product/evidence snapshot and financial values for one shopping line.

SessionItemQuality.title: SessionItemQuality
SessionItemQuality.description: Historical evidence summary; exact tiers and full assessment survive even when score/band are null.

ProductRanking.title: ProductRanking
ProductRanking.description: Nutri-Score letter grade and optional raw formula calculation points. Points are not a percentage and lower is generally better; thresholds depend on category and algorithm version.

calculationPoints.description: Raw Nutri-Score formula points; intentionally not bounded to 0–100.

score.description: Deprecated legacy field read only during migration.

DaratCircle.description: A Darat (rotating savings circle) owned by one organizer and shared with invited members. One currency per circle, one schedule, one rotation algorithm.

organizerId.description: uid of the circle creator and sole owner of the lifecycle

fixedOrder.description: Agreed order of uids for `fixed` rotation, recipient of round 1 first

randomSeed.description: Seed for the random rotation; same seed → same order on every device

memberOrder.description: Member uids in join order; used as tie-breaker and as the order bidders are evaluated

rounds.description: The full schedule of rounds, one per member

DaratRound.description: One scheduled round in a Darat circle: one pot, one recipient, one per-member payment map.

recipientId.description: uid of the member who receives the pot; null for undecided bidding rounds

discount.description: For bidding rounds: the discount the winner offered, redistributed to the rest

payments.description: Per-member payment status for this round

DaratMember.description: A member of a Darat circle. uid-indexed, one document per member.

sourcePlaceId.description: Money place id the user funds contributions from

phone.description: Phone number carried over from the invite (or empty for the organizer). The rules require it to pass the loose shape check when present.

DaratInvite.description: Code-scoped, expiry-bound invitation to join a Darat circle. The doc id is the UUID code the recipient pastes or follows from a share link.

phone.description: Loose phone number typed by the organizer (8+ digits, separators allowed). Reference, not a gate.

DaratLedgerEntry.description: Immutable audit entry for a Darat mutation. Patterned on the existing LedgerEntry but circle-scoped.

ProductAssessment.title: ProductAssessment
ProductAssessment.description: Complete immutable ingredient identity/evidence/context assessment. Numeric score and band may be null when unsupported.

ExpenseProductAttachment.title: ExpenseProductAttachment
ExpenseProductAttachment.description: Confirmed scan snapshot attached to a variable expense.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account configuration and plan details.

plan.description: Coarse plan projection. Effective Pro access also requires an unexpired entitlement. Browser clients may perform exactly one rules-validated free -> pro launch-trial transition lasting 90 days; future Stripe/CMI webhooks update the provider-neutral entitlement fields through Firebase Admin SDK.

planBillingCycle.description: Billing cycle selected at checkout, written to Firebase alongside `plan`

planNextBillingDate.description: Next billing date (YYYY-MM-DD) written to Firebase when `plan` upgrades

avatarUrl.description: Persisted profile image: a small JPEG data URL or HTTPS identity-provider photo.

householdMembers.description: Legacy local profile labels retained for backward compatibility; not authoritative membership.

defaultCategoryBudgets.description: Pro feature: default per-category budgets applied to new months

enableRollover.description: Pro feature: carry unused category budget into the next month

fixedCategories.description: User-defined fixed-bill categories shown in the Add Fixed Charge modal

monthStartDate.description: Payday of the Personal workspace: the day of the month its budget month starts; mirrors the per-source salary start date

householdMonthStartDate.description: Payday of the Household workspace, stored per workspace so switching workspace does not change the other one. Falls back to monthStartDate while unset.

moneyPlaces.description: Cash locations (Bank, Home, Wallet, plus any the user added)

reminderPrefs.description: Pro: reminder channel preferences (bills / goals / email digest).

pushSubscriptions.description: Pro: Web Push subscriptions of this account's devices (max 10).

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by the reminder dispatcher.

email.description: Sign-in email, copied only when the email digest is enabled.

goalTargetDates.description: Pro: savings goal target dates (goalId → YYYY-MM-DD).

debtPayoffBudget.description: Pro: monthly amount committed to the debt payoff plan.

MonthBudget.title: MonthBudget
MonthBudget.description: Monthly budget state including money places and expenses.

periodStatus.description: Closed periods are read-only until an explicit owner reopen.

incomeSources.description: Defaults to a single 'Primary Income' source equal to totalBudget

customRatios.description: Definable Needs/Wants/Savings split, applied when strategyId is 'custom'

variableCategoryBases.description: Planned amount per category for variable spending

fixedCategoryBases.description: Planned amount per category for fixed bills

categoryBudgets.description: Pro feature: planned maximum per category for the month

rolloverFromPrevious.description: Pro feature: unused category budgets rolled over from the previous month

categoryColors.description: Category name to hex colour, e.g. #f97316

categoryIcons.description: Category name to Material Symbols icon name

savingsActivity.description: Deposit / withdrawal log feeding the home-screen Recent Activity list

placeBalances.description: Balances for user-defined money sources (beyond bank / home / wallet)

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write

kind.description: household = shared family budget; business = second solo workspace (auto-entrepreneur). Missing = household.

Household.description: Authoritative shared-workspace configuration and immutable projection of the owner entitlement.

permissions.description: Legacy-only custom permission map; authorization maps stored roles to rules-enforceable document access.

HouseholdMember.description: UID-indexed active membership or pending/profile row. Firestore Rules enforce role-level document access.

permissions.description: Legacy-only custom permission map; authorization maps stored roles to rules-enforceable document access.

HouseholdInvite.description: Verified-email invitation with a numeric Rules-enforced expiry and auditable acceptance projection.

HouseholdInvoice.description: Contributor-owned submission. Approval atomically posts a deterministic expense and immutable ledger entry.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Self-learning catalog record keyed by canonical zero-filled GTIN-14, with source and field-level provenance.

origin.description: Trusted provider origin only; never inferred from a GS1 prefix.

CourseSession.title: CourseSession
CourseSession.description: Revisioned shopping session. A completed session is its historical bill and retains immutable product/evidence snapshots.

place.description: Money place the course was paid from

loggedExpenseId.description: Id of the variable expense the total was logged as (idempotency link)

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: Immutable idempotency and audit record for a finance mutation.

/users/{uid}/products/{barcode}.description: Private product catalog keyed by zero-filled canonical GTIN-14

/households/{householdId}.description: Shared household workspace and authoritative configuration

/households/{householdId}/invoices/{invo.description: Contributor submissions with atomic approval posting

/circles/{circleId}.description: Shared Darat circle document; readable by all members, writable by the organizer

/circles/{circleId}/members/{uid}.description: Per-member roster for a Darat circle. Members can write their own row (e.g. leave); organizer can write any row

/circles/{circleId}/ledger/{entryId}.description: Immutable audit trail for circle mutations

/daratInvites/{inviteId}.description: Top-level invite lookup so the join page can resolve a code without knowing the circle id

/users/{uid}/circles/{circleId}.description: Lightweight per-user pointer so the dashboard widget can list 'your circles' without scanning the shared collection
